notes: This is al-Faqih's statement of his routes to Ziyad b. Marwan al-Qandi, with no saying (rule 11). The reading is given as a best guess and the ruling is flagged.
«أبي» is the Faqih's father, named by relation only (rule 7). «محمد بن عيسى بن عبيد» and «يعقوب بن يزيد» are co-transmitters at one level, joined by «و» after a semicolon.
